Bash(powershell.exe -Command "cd ''C:\\Users\\alexm\\source\\repos\\miyaarekkusu\\HEWSakuhin\\appfew''; python manage.py shell -c @''
from monotal.models import *
from django.db.models import Q

u = User.objects.filter\(email=""alexmiyasaki123@gmail.com""\).first\(\)
if u:
    uid = u.user_id
    print\(f""Found: {u.user_name} id={uid}""\)

    # InsuranceClaim -> InsuranceClaimImage
    claims = InsuranceClaim.objects.filter\(Q\(rental_history__lender_user_id=uid\) | Q\(rental_history__renter_user_id=uid\)\)
    InsuranceClaimImage.objects.filter\(claim__in=claims\).delete\(\)
    claims.delete\(\)

    InsuranceEnrollment.objects.filter\(user_id=uid\).delete\(\)
    RentalHistory.objects.filter\(Q\(lender_user_id=uid\) | Q\(renter_user_id=uid\)\).delete\(\)
    RentalRequest.objects.filter\(Q\(requester_user_id=uid\) | Q\(requested_user_id=uid\)\).delete\(\)
    Product.objects.filter\(user_id=uid\).delete\(\)
    UserAddress.objects.filter\(user_id=uid\).delete\(\)

    result = u.delete\(\)
    print\(f""Deleted: {result}""\)
else:
    print\(""User not found""\)
''@")
